question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only one person sits to the right of B. E sits third from the left end of the row. G is the immediate neighbour of F and B. C sits to the immediate left of A. How many people sit to the left of D?
solution:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north.

 
• Only one person sits to the right of B.
 
• E sits third from the left end of the row.
 
• G is the immediate neighbour of F and B.
 
• C sits to the immediate left of A.
